cards.ex: I always avoid driving in the city center during rush hour.
cards.exUz: Men har doim tirband paytida shahar markazida mashina haydashdan qochaman.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishdan o'zingizni tiyish, qilmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to seeing you next week.
cards.exUz: Men seni keyingi hafta ko'rishni juda intizorlik bilan kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishini yoki qilishini katta qiziqish bilan kutish.

cards.ex: I can't help laughing when he tells jokes.
cards.exUz: U hazil aytganda, men kula olmayman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni biron ish qilishdan to'xtata olmaslik, majburiy ravishda qilish.

cards.ex: It's no use trying to convince him; he's made up his mind.
cards.exUz: Uni ishontirishga urinishdan foyda yo'q; u o'z fikrini o'zgartirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishdan hech qanday natija chiqmasligi, behuda urinish.

cards.ex: I finally got around to cleaning the garage this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat shu hafta oxirida garajni tozalashga vaqt topdim.
cards.uzDef: Nihoyat biror ishni qilish uchun vaqt topish.

cards.ex: I'm used to working long hours, so it doesn't bother me.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq soatlar ishlashga o'rganib qolganman, shuning uchun bu meni bezovta qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni doimiy ravishda qilib, odatlanib qolgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: People tend to eat more unhealthy food when they are stressed.
cards.exUz: Odamlar stressda bo'lganlarida ko'proq zararli ovqatlar yeyishga moyil bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda biron ish qilishga moyil bo'lish.

cards.ex: I want to learn to play the guitar this year.
cards.exUz: Men bu yil gitara chalishni o'rganmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani qanday qilishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: I managed to finish the project just before the deadline.
cards.exUz: Men loyihani muddat tugashidan oldin tugatishga erishdim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan bo'lsa ham, biror ishni muvaffaqiyatli bajarish.

cards.ex: He refused to apologize for his behavior.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatti-harakatlari uchun kechirim so'rashni rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishni qat'iyan xohlamaslik.

cards.ex: We decided to go on vacation to Italy this summer.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yoz Italiyaga ta'tilga borishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishga qat'iy qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I hope to see you again soon.
cards.exUz: Men seni tez orada yana ko'rishga umid qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish bo'lishiga yoki qilishga umid qilish.

cards.ex: He pretended to be asleep so he wouldn't have to talk to her.
cards.exUz: U u bilan gaplashmaslik uchun o'zini uxlayotgandek ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa aslida unday bo'lmasa ham, shundaydek ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We can't afford to go on vacation this year.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yil ta'tilga borishga imkonimiz yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga puli yetarli bo'lish yoki ruxsat bera olish.

cards.ex: I'm considering changing my job.
cards.exUz: Men ishimni o'zgartirishni o'ylab ko'ryapman.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishni rejalashtirish yoki muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: You need to practice speaking English more often.
cards.exUz: Siz ingliz tilida ko'proq gapirishni mashq qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni yaxshiroq bajarish uchun takroriy mashq qilish.

cards.ex: Please stop talking during the movie.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, kino davomida gapirishni to'xtating.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni qilishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Do you mind helping me with this?
cards.exUz: Mengа bu bilan yordam berishga qarshi emasmisiz?
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishga qarshi bo'lish yoki bezovta bo'lish.

cards.ex: Keep practicing, and you'll improve.
cards.exUz: Mashq qilishda davom eting va siz yaxshilanasiz.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni to'xtamasdan davom ettirish.

cards.ex: He insisted on paying for dinner.
cards.exUz: U kechki ovqat uchun to'lashni talab qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni qilishni qat'iy talab qilish.

cards.ex: Arguing with him is a waste of time.
cards.exUz: U bilan bahslashish vaqtni behuda sarflashdir.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtni befoyda sarflash, behuda ish bilan shug'ullanish.

cards.ex: I have trouble remembering names.
cards.exUz: Men ismlarni eslab qolishda qiynalaman.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni bajarishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: It's worth visiting the museum while you're in town.
cards.exUz: Shaharda bo'lganingizda muzeyga tashrif buyurishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Biron ish qilishga arziydigan bo'lish, foydali bo'lish.

cards.ex: To make matters worse, it started raining.
cards.exUz: Vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirib, yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirish, muammoni kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: It takes time to get used to living in a new city.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharda yashashga ko'nikish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi odatlarga moslashish, o'rganib qolish.

cards.ex: It's likely to rain tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'ishi ehtimoli bor.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa bo'lish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lish.

cards.ex: This is a great chance to improve your skills.
cards.exUz: Bu sizning ko'nikmalaringizni yaxshilash uchun ajoyib imkoniyat.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa qilish uchun qulay fursat.

cards.ex: Hard work is the key to success.
cards.exUz: Mehnatkashlik muvaffaqiyat kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga erishish uchun asosiy omil.

cards.ex: Make sure to lock the door when you leave.
cards.exUz: Ketayotganda eshikni qulflashga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni qilishingizga amin bo'lish, ehtiyot chorasini ko'rish.

cards.ex: I find it hard to concentrate when there's noise.
cards.exUz: Shovqin bo'lganda diqqatimni jamlashni qiyin deb topaman.
cards.uzDef: Biron ishni qilish qiyin yoki og'ir deb hisoblash.
